comment: Scenario -> existing CP tests, invoked by name from the checkout under test (CP #269 head, which carries #266 and the 5b consume test). Scenarios with an empty test list are BLOCKED on packet P0 (dispatch-only recovery source) and can never read as PASS. non_native_reference lists real tests that exist but do NOT run on PostgreSQL; they never turn a scenario to PASS.

scenarios.title: approval standing GRANTED/non-revoked at hold (FOR SHARE) and withdrawal FOR UPDATE conflict
scenarios.blocked_on: no native-PG test exists. Control #76 (314039111) tests run on in-memory SQLite, so FOR SHARE at hold / FOR UPDATE withdrawal locking is unprovable there; CP #272 (73f88f1c) has no store-level test either. A builder must add a real-PG test (hold under FOR SHARE vs concurrent withdrawal under FOR UPDATE).

expiry judged on store_now() for renew, covers and release; a late release is refused
first-commit dispatch-only recovery: same coordinates, fresh hold, one-use, a second use refused
scenarios.blocked_on: no native-PG test exists. The recovery semantics are tested on in-memory SQLite in Control #76 and as unit tests in CP #272; they do not prove first-commit recovery on PostgreSQL. A builder must add a real-PG test.
